title: Shopify–NetSuite Sync for Household Brands: Map Refills, Concentrates, and Multipacks
summary: Map each Shopify variant to the NetSuite refill, concentrate, or multipack item so orders and kits carry physical pack counts instead of advertised yield.
body_markdown:
## The operating decision


Household-brand two-way sync should preserve the difference between a refill, concentrate, ready-to-use product, and multipack. Map each Shopify variant to an approved ERP sellable definition. Similar intended use or advertised yield does not establish product equivalence, so keep actual package quantities separate from marketing claims about the amount a concentrate can produce.


Explore the complete[household consumables integration and automation hub](https://www.stacksync.com/industry/cpg/household-consumables) for the systems and processes around this guide.
